arxiv-2108-10012.title: Measurement of global polarization of Λ \Lambda hyperons in Au+Au s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} = 7.2 GeV fixed target collisions at RHIC-STAR experiment
arxiv-2108-10012.creator: \firstname Kosuke \lastname Okubo (for the STAR Collaboration)
arxiv-2108-10012.description: Abstract In non-central nuclear collisions, the created matter should exhibit strong vorticity, which induces spin polarization. Global polarization is a good tool to investigate the dynamics of the system. Global polarization of Λ \Lambda and Λ ¯ \bar{\Lambda} hyperons has been measured at s NN \sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}} = 2.4 GeV - 5.02 TeV in various experiments.

arxiv-2209-00705.title: Finite groups with large Chermak-Delgado lattices
arxiv-2209-00705.creator: Georgiana Fasolă, Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2209-00705.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Georgiana Fasolă, Marius Tărnăuceanu. Given a finite group G G , we denote by L ⁡ ( G ) L(G) the subgroup lattice of G G and by 𝒞𝒟 ⁡ ( G ) {\cal CD}(G) the Chermak-Delgado lattice of G G . In this note, we determine the finite groups G G such that | 𝒞𝒟 ⁡ ( G ) | = | L ⁡ ( G ) | − k |{\cal CD}(G)|=|L(G)|-k , k = 1 , 2 k=1,2 .

arxiv-2301-10716.title: Investigating Strategies for Clause Recommendation
arxiv-2301-10716.creator: Sagar Joshi \orcid 0000-0001-6095-9713, Sumanth Balaji \orcid 0000-0002-5669-7519, Jerrin Thomas, Aparna Garimella, Vasudeva Varma
arxiv-2301-10716.description: Abstract Clause recommendation is the problem of recommending a clause to a legal contract, given the context of the contract in question and the clause type to which the clause should belong. With not much prior work being done toward the generation of legal contracts, this problem was proposed as a first step toward the bigger problem of contract generation.

arxiv-2510-11856.title: Actor-Enriched Time Series Forecasting of Process Performance
arxiv-2510-11856.creator: Aurélie Leribaux, Rafael Oyamada, Johannes De Smedt, Zahra Dasht Bozorgi, Artem Polyvyanyy, Jochen De Weerdt
arxiv-2510-11856.description: Abstract Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) is a key task in Process Mining that aims to predict future behavior, outcomes, or performance indicators. Accurate prediction of the latter is critical for proactive decision-making. Given that processes are often resource-driven, understanding and incorporating actor behavior in forecasting is crucial.

pmc-11368326.title: Prevalence and correlates of depression, anxiety, and stress among adolescents in urban and rural areas of Mysuru, South India
pmc-11368326.creator: G. Hari Prakash, D. Sunil Kumar, Vanishri Arun, Saurish Hegde, Deepika Yadav, Arun Gopi
pmc-11368326.description: Background:Adolescence, a volatile period of growth between the ages of 10 and 19, is associated with increased vulnerability to mental health problems. Factors such as academic pressure can contribute to these challenges.Objectives:The current study aimed to evaluate the factors and prevalence of depression, anxiety, and stress among adolescents in the urban and rural areas of Mysuru district.

pmc-11505394.title: Long-Lived Triplets from Singlet Fission in Pentacene-Decorated Helical Supramolecular Polymers
pmc-11505394.creator: Giulia Lavarda, Ashish Sharma, Marko Beslać, Stef A. H. Jansen, Stefan C. J. Meskers, Richard H. Friend, Akshay Rao, E. W. Meijer
pmc-11505394.description: Singlet fission (SF), which involves the conversion of a singlet excited state into two triplet excitons, holds great potential to boost the efficiency of photovoltaics. However, losses due to triplet–triplet annihilation hamper the efficient harvesting of SF-generated triplet excitons, which limits an effective implementation in solar energy conversion schemes.

pmc-11611567.title: Integrative analysis of metabolites and microbial diversity revealed metabolic mechanism of coarse feeding tolerance in Songliao Black sows during gestation
pmc-11611567.creator: Jinbo Zhao, Wenjiang Zhao, Jiaqiang Dong, Hong Zhang, Kun Yang, Shengyue Gao, Wanyu Feng, Yan Song, Meiyu Qi, Xinmiao He
pmc-11611567.description: Dietary fiber is a key nutritional regulatory factor that has been studied intensively for its role in improving reproduction in sows during gestation. However, the metabolic mechanism underlying the effect of interactions between metabolites and gut microbes on coarse feeding tolerance in indigenous sows remains to be elucidated.

pmc-11629384.title: The Circulating Proteome—Technological Developments, Current Challenges, and Future Trends

pmc-11629384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Recent improvements in proteomics technologies have fundamentally altered our capacities to characterize human biology. There is an ever-growing interest in using these novel methods for studying the circulating proteome, as blood offers an accessible window into human health. However, every methodological innovation and analytical progress calls for reassessing our existing approaches and routines to ensure that the new data will add value to the greater biomedical research community and avoid previous errors.

pmc-11678359.title: Planting the Seed of Epistemic Curiosity: The Role of the Satisfaction of the Needs for Autonomy and Competence
pmc-11678359.creator: Lizbeth Puerta-Sierra, Rogelio Puente-Díaz
pmc-11678359.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We posit that curiosity, an epistemic emotion, is an integral part of entrepreneurial education, entrepreneurial activities, and learning, which seek to develop an entrepreneurial mindset, a form of cognitive ability. The purpose of the present investigation was to examine the influence of autonomy and competence satisfaction on epistemic curiosity and the influence of epistemic curiosity on epistemic satisfaction and performance on epistemic activities in entrepreneurial education. Participants completed a battery of questionnaires in three waves of data collection.

pmc-12395615.title: Elite beach volleyball match analysis: rally structure, work-to-rest patterns, and gender considerations
pmc-12395615.creator: Flavia F Pereira, Jennifer Austin, Jose Antonio, Riceler Waske, Victor Romano
pmc-12395615.description: BackgroundBeach volleyball has undergone significant evolution since its Olympic inception in 1996, with changes in scoring systems, court size, and match rules. These modifications have altered the physical and tactical demands on athletes, leading to shorter match durations and increased intensity of competition.

pmc-12773512.title: Abstract 200: ICA Lesion Etiology does not affect the Outcomes after Endovascular Treatment of Acute Tandem LVO
pmc-12773512.creator: Milagros R. Galecio Castillo, Mudassir Farooqui, Ameer Hassan, Mouhammad Jumaa, Afshin Divani, Marc Ribo, Michael Abraham, Nils Petersen, Johanna Fifi, Waldo Guerrero, Amer Malik, James Siegler, Thanh Nguyen, Sunil Sheth, Albert Yoo, Guillermo Linares, Nazli Janjua, Darko Quispe‐Orozco, Wondewossen
pmc-12773512.description: IntroductionTandem lesions (TLs) are present in up to 15% of patients with stroke due to acute large vessel occlusions.(1) Nevertheless, published research on endovascular treatment outcomes in this population is scarce. Although TLs are most commonly of atherosclerotic etiology, some patients present with dissection of the ICA.

pmc-12971390.title: Proton Beam Therapy Versus Photon Radiotherapy for Pediatric Neuroblastoma: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis (TRP‐2025 Neuroblastoma)
pmc-12971390.creator: Hazuki Nitta, Masashi Mizumoto, Kazushi Maruo, Yoshiko Oshiro, Yinuo Li, Masako Inaba, Takashi Saito, Sho Hosaka, Takashi Iizumi, Hiroko Fukushima, Ryoko Suzuki, Shosei Shimizu, Kei Nakai, Hideyuki Sakurai
pmc-12971390.description: Background/ObjectivesRadiotherapy (RT) is a standard component of treatment for high‐risk pediatric neuroblastoma. Proton beam therapy (PBT) offers dosimetric advantages over photon radiotherapy (XRT), but comparative clinical data remain limited.MethodsAs part of the review project at our facility, we conducted a systematic review and meta‐analysis comparing survival outcomes between PBT and XRT.

pmc-13128506.title: Establishment of a Gastric Cancer Diagnostic Model Based on the Combined Evaluation of Peripheral Blood Immune-inflammatory Nutritional Indicators and Tumor Markers
pmc-13128506.creator: Ke Chen, Jinglue Han, Xiaoxue Zhang, He Nie, Lijia Ding, Lin Ji, Huazhen Zhang, Jie Yin, Yunan Zhang, Wenying Tian, Jiale Lv, Qiang Zhan, Fangmei An, Zhifa Lv, Shuping Si
pmc-13128506.description: This study aimed to develop a non-invasive diagnostic model for gastric cancer (GC) by combining serum immune-inflammatory-nutrition indicators with traditional tumor markers to improve early diagnosis efficiency. Our retrospective analysis included 3,464 participants, comprising 833 GC patients and 2,631 chronic gastritis controls, recruited between January 2018 and July 2025.

pmc-13134521.title: Systematic Multiplatform Discovery of Methylation Markers Enables Non‐Invasive Early Detection of Endometrial Cancer
pmc-13134521.creator: Yan Cai, Shuchao Chen, Zhen Wu, Jinxia Guan, Jie Zhao, Jianwei Ye, Baochen Du, Xiaoliang Han, Tong Shu, Guangpeng Zhou, Hong Zheng
pmc-13134521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Endometrial cancer, the most common gynecological malignancy with an annual increase of 1%–3%, lacks suitable noninvasive diagnostic tools, as current methods like hysteroscopy and biopsy are invasive and impractical for routine screening. We conducted a comprehensive, multilayered marker discovery workflow integrating whole‐genome bisulfite sequencing and targeted methylation panels in tumor and control tissues, then prioritized and optimized candidates for detection in cervical exfoliated cells.

pmc-13267155.title: Multi‐Omics and Machine Learning Integration Identifies Key Endothelial Modules in Carotid Artery Stenosis
pmc-13267155.creator: Jiayi Wu, Chunguang Guo, Linfeng Zhang, Gaopo Cai, Yi Liu, Kai Tang
pmc-13267155.description: BackgroundCarotid artery stenosis (CAS) is a major cause of ischemic stroke, yet reliable molecular biomarkers for early identification remain limited.MethodsWe integrated single‐cell RNA sequencing (scRNA‐seq), bulk transcriptomics, and in‐house multi‐omics data, applying WGCNA and machine learning to identify endothelial cell‐derived diagnostic biomarkers, validated across independent GEO and ZZ cohorts at single‐cell, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels.

pmc-13371894.title: A fungal subtilase-like protease SBT1 blocks rice immunity by erasing the MAPKKKα signaling node
pmc-13371894.creator: Yuan Fang, Zhaoyun Wang, Wenjing Li, Ji Wu, Jing Chen, Qiutao Xu, Tom Hsiang, Xiaoyang Chen
pmc-13371894.description: Rice (Oryza sativa) is highly susceptible to a variety of devastating fungal diseases. However, whether these phylogenetically distinct fungal pathogens employ conserved effectors to disrupt common immune hubs remains unclear. Here, we identify a conserved virulence strategy in which multiple rice-infecting fungal pathogens employ a subtilisin-like protease effector, SBT1, to suppress host immunity.

pmc-13494977.title: Mycobacteria as evolutionary drivers of host innate immunity: insights from comparing experimental host models
pmc-13494977.creator: Mariona Cortacans, Pere-Joan Cardona
pmc-13494977.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The genus Mycobacterium exerts a strong selective force, shaping the evolution and structure of innate immune systems across various hosts and revealing overarching, conserved principles of host defense. Despite their phylogenetic distance, amoebae, nematodes, insects, wax moth larvae, and zebrafish share fundamental innate immune strategies while also exhibiting key differences in tissue organization, immune complexity, and the presence or absence of adaptive immunity.
